status_meanings.native: Concrete native operation exists; does not claim full old-test parity or hardware verification.
status_meanings.partial: Specific semantic/workflow subset exists; notes describe the remaining work.
status_meanings.protocol-only: Raw native protocol transaction exists; typed high-level implementation remains.
status_meanings.pending: Requested semantic behavior is not implemented.
status_meanings.platform-difference: Mobile OS API is inapplicable or replaced explicitly on Windows.
